name: OAHExposurePathway
title: OneAquaHealth Environmental Exposure Pathways
publisher: OneAquaHealth Consortium - Semantic Interoperability Working Group
description: Pathways through which human populations encounter aquatic hazards in urban water environments.

concept.definition: Primary or secondary dermal/mucosal contact during urban water recreation (swimming, kayaking, paddleboarding, wading).
Ingestion of untreated or compromised water abstracted from raw surface water intake zones.
Inhalation of wind-borne or fountain/aerator aerosolized cyanotoxins or microbial particulates.
Transmission via bites from hematophagous dipteran vectors breeding along urban riparian margins.
